summary: First testing run for Xaluca Tours MVP. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (root, valid contact submit, persistence verification, invalid email, missing required fields, short message, minimal payload, no _id leak). Frontend: All 8 required sections render with correct data-testids, language switcher (EN/FR/ES) updates hero copy, header drawer + anchor navigation works, hero slide indicators switch slides, testimonials prev/next/dot work, Leaflet map renders with 12 markers, contact form submits successfully and shows success card + 'Send another' restores the form, HTML5 validation blocks empty submit, and zero horizontal overflow at 375/768/1280 viewports. End-to-end POST contact-requests from UI to MongoDB verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: list endpoint converts created_at strings back to datetime in Python loop after Mongo projection — fine but could be skipped since response_model serializes either way (minor perf).
Backend: POST /api/contact-requests returns 200; consider 201 Created for REST hygiene (non-blocking).

Frontend: Hero slide indicator clicks are functionally correct but slides also auto-advance every 7s — clicking an indicator does not reset the auto-rotate timer, which can cause perceived 'jumpiness' for users. Consider clearing/restarting interval on manual interaction.
Frontend: ContactForm shows toast.error generically; consider surfacing 422 field-level errors (e.g., email format) to the form for better UX.
Frontend: 'Send another' button label is hardcoded English even when site language is FR/ES — should be wired through the i18n t() function.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this MVP
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed contact_requests in MongoDB via backend tests and one Playwright submission ('Playwright User' / playwright@example.com). Not cleaned up — visible in GET /api/contact-requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py (pytest, 10 tests, <1s). Frontend public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Language persists in localStorage — reset key before language-switch UI tests for deterministic state. Hero auto-rotates every 7s — guard against race conditions when asserting active slide class. Note that localStorage key name is whatever LanguageContext.jsx uses; clearing/setting localStorage.clear() is safest.
rca of the issue: No production issues found. Two non-issues observed during initial run: (1) 'Hero EN title FAIL' was caused by lingering ES preference in browser localStorage from an earlier interactive QA — verified working when localStorage is cleared. (2) 'Slide indicator class unchanged' was a race with the 7s auto-rotate making idx already match the clicked index — verified working by clicking a different indicator and re-asserting.
